refnamediv.refpurpose: Enumeration representing the status of a SilikoToken

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoTokenStatus enumeration represents what kind of token a SilikoToken holds, such as a single-character token, an integer, a real number, or a function identifier.

listitem.para: SilikoTokenUnset: The token is not set and holds no usable value.
SilikoTokenInteger: The token is an integer.
SilikoTokenReal: The token is a real number.
SilikoTokenCharacter: The token is a character, such as an operator or parenthesis.
SilikoTokenId: The token is a function identifier
SilikoTokenEndOfInput: The token represents the end of input for the lexer.
